pages.description: Create a landscape scientific framework diagram for sparse-well to dense 3D porosity reconstruction. Do not add an overall title. LEFT DOMAIN ANCHOR: sparse well observations (x_i, y_i), a three-channel seismic volume X_s in R^(B×3×D×H×W), and structural query coordinates q in R^(N×F). COOL-BLUE RELIABLE MAIN PATH: ordinary kriging with a variogram card and weighted spatial neighbors; embed y_hat_OK(x_0) = sum_i lambda_i y_i with sum_i lambda_i = 1. WARM-ORANGE FOUNDATION SIDE PATH: three seismic channels enter a real pretrained OpenMind-MAE encoder shown as 3D patch tokens and stacked 2.5D residual encoder blocks, producing channel tokens K,V in R^(N×3×d). CENTRAL CROSS-ATTENTION: structured queries Q = W_Q q attend to K = W_K h and V = W_V h through A = softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d))V; a residual head outputs r_hat. TEAL SAFE FUSION: y_hat = y_hat_OK ⊕ g_consensus gamma r_hat. Show a prominent grey four-inner-fold consensus gate that closes unless every inner spatial fold improves over kriging; gate-zero must visibly route the exact PyKrige result unchanged. RIGHT OUTPUT: a dense 3D porosity volume, a residual volume and an uncertainty/diagnostic slice. BOTTOM TRAINING STRIP: locked outer spatial folds -> inner-fold train-only preprocessing and residual fitting -> four-fold consensus safety test -> paired three-seed diagnostic -> default route selection; make clear the current safe route may tie the baseline. Label query and token dimensions. No experimental metric values, no learning rates, no paragraphs.
